writable_profile_audit.conclusion: All currently exposed Optolink-backed writable controls in the live VDensHO1 HA profile resolve to one-byte datapoints.
writable_profile_audit.service_config: Existing /set controls map to already-polled one-byte 0x27xx/0x57xx/0x67xx datapoints.
writable_profile_audit.caveat: Transport width is covered; semantic behavior of every source-documented service coding is not thereby proven.

final_integration_gate.purpose: Exercise the real running splitter write route under temporary permanent VS1 using MQTT /set, with an isolated temporary MQTT namespace.
final_integration_gate.route: mqtt_util.handle_set_topic -> cmnd_queue -> requests_util.response_to_request -> vs12_adapter.write_datapoint_ext -> stock optolinkvs1 F4
isolation: Temporary unique mqtt_topic/mqtt_listen/mqtt_respond namespace prevents existing HA entities from targeting the test splitter.
cleanup: If not verified, up to two cleanup attempts occur through the running splitter.
If still not verified, the temporary splitter is stopped and a direct stock VS1/F4 fallback restores the known baseline.
Original settings must be byte-exactly restored.
If baseline or settings restoration cannot be verified, splitter and Party are left stopped fail-closed and the settings backup is retained.
On normal success the splitter must re-establish VS2/300 before Party is restored.

live_run.write_route: MQTT /set -> mqtt_util.handle_set_topic -> cmnd_queue -> requests_util.response_to_request -> vs12_adapter.write_datapoint_ext -> stock optolinkvs1.write_datapoint_ext/F4
conclusion: The actual production MQTT /set write path through the running splitter successfully changed 0x2306 from 21 C to 22 C under temporary permanent VS1.
The normal splitter readback path published the changed value 22 and later the restored value 21.
The same production /set path restored 0x2306 to 21 C; no direct fallback was needed.
MainPID remained stable, no unexpected restart occurred, original settings were restored byte-for-byte, and VS2/300 baseline was re-established.
live_run.note: The helper printed 'ERROR: 0' before/after the successful run because its outer BaseException handler also catches SystemExit(0). This is a cosmetic helper bug; the process exit status and RESULT were PASS.

final_conclusion: No transport-level or splitter-integration blocker remains for permanent VS1 on this exact WB2A/VDensHO1 installation. Remaining work is deployment engineering: persist the read-only GFA 0x6B patch, add guarded P80/P06/P09/P87 polling, switch settings to permanent VS1, and make installer/updater reapply/verify the integration.
